title: Geometric String Art
description: An abstract composition featuring vibrant geometric shapes including triangles, circles, and angular forms in bright pink, orange, teal, and purple. Black string is stretched across the surface, anchored by numerous pins, creating intersecting lines over a black painted background with visible brushstrokes and white accents.
prompt: abstract geometric painting on black background featuring bright pink, orange, teal and purple triangles, circles and angular shapes. Black string is stretched and wrapped around numerous pins creating intersecting linear patterns across the composition. Visible brushstrokes, bold color blocking with striped patterns within some shapes, dynamic and energetic arrangement
